idea-plugin.name: Properties-To-Yaml
idea-plugin.description:
Properties-To-Yaml is a JetBrains IDE plugin that simplifies the conversion between Java properties files and YAML format.

Features:
  • Convert .properties files to .yml format with a simple UI
  • Convert .yml files back to .properties format
  • Preserve hierarchical structure using dot notation in property keys
  • Preserve comments in both conversion directions
  • Provide a live preview of the YAML output before saving
  • Maintain proper indentation and formatting in the generated YAML

Usage:
  1. Open the "PropertiesToYaml" tool window from the IDE sidebar
  2. Right-click on a .properties file and select "Convert to YAML"
  3. Right-click on a .yml file and select "Convert to Properties"
